reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 13 points better, in a game of about 243 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Bulls.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 80 times in 100, by about 11; most games like this end between 216 and 264 total points.
